_note: Page for teachers (SI suggestion chosen by the author, 15 Nov; challenge text: "an educational tool to help students and the public understand lunar exploration challenges"). One class activity in steps; each step has a question and a link to the game or to a scenario of the Compare tool. The page holds no answers: they appear in the tool when the link is opened. minutes = suggested time per step (the total is shown). facts = rows of the Moon and Earth table (item k), values quoted from config/moon-earth.json. Text in i18n/en.json teach.*.
